contexts.text: Exult over her, Heaven () = that now the Angels of Heaven may rejoice; for exultation is joy of heart. AE 1179.
To rejoice and exult () = joy of soul and of heart.
Their joy from instruction in truths and illumination, is signified by to exult, etc.
Exultation = its delight from good; and gladness, its delight from truth.
Their delights are meant by exultation, etc.
Drunkenness and exultation = insanities in the highest degree.
Exultation is sometimes mentioned instead of joy; because exultation, like joy, is said of good, because of love, of the heart, and of the will. Illustrated.
In all these passages, exultation = delight from the love and affection of good; and gladness, pleasantness from the love and affection of truth.
The hills gird themselves with exultation () = that the goods in them receive truths with joy of heart.
They shall be brought with joy and exultation () = with heavenly joy.
To exult = joy from the affection of good; for to exult is of the heart, thus of the good of love.
